exact_statement: For every Boolean core g and edit region E on a uniform cube, with a=g, b=g*(-1)^1_E, J=(I(a)+I(b))/2 and kappa=I((a-b)/2), exactly 2*kappa-J=P_in-P_out, where P_in and P_out are the contributions to I(g) of pivotal edges entirely inside and outside E. Thus half-private kappa<=J/2 holds iff P_in<=P_out, in particular for all independent edit sets and all point edits of arbitrary cores. For point edits in dimension m, delta=2^-m, kappa=m*delta/2 and J>=m*delta. Products of disjoint arbitrary private cores activated through arbitrary masks on two shared bits, with edit densities<=1/2 and P_in<=P_out, have a prescribed z-then-w stopping prefix with T_private<=2*J and exact total derivative charge T=T_private+2*E_zw<=2*J+d<=2*I. For arbitrary edit regions of density<=1/2 the exact signed identity T_private=2*J+W holds, W=sum_j,direction E_other[Q_-j*(P_in-P_out)_j,edge]. Supplied normalized complete four-leaf references of average cost cbar lift to one normalized root reference with CE<=cbar+T+(3/ln2)*d; cbar<=C*J implies CE<=max(C+2,1+3/ln2)*I. An actual two-bit core/edit pair with J=1,kappa=3/4,q=0 refutes the unconditional half-private extension. No universal supply of terminal slack or recursive reference is claimed.

exact_statement: For any r>=1, Boolean cores g_j on disjoint private uniform cubes, and one common independent fair bit z, let F=product_j g_j on z0 and constant1 on z1. Each supplied normalized complete spectral reference Q_j has finite cost c_j. Set P=product_j ghat_j^2, Q=product_j Q_j, mu=product_j E g_j, R=(P+delta_empty)/2, q=(Q+delta_empty)/2 and Q_F(A,T)=actual_nu_F(A|T) q(T), with any fixed conditional on zero true rows. This is a normalized finite-cost parent reference, with H(F)=sum H(g_j)/2+Psi(mu), I(F)=sum I(g_j)/2+(1-mu)/2, and CE_QF=sum c_j/2+Psi(mu)-D_ref. Here Psi(mu)=eta((1+mu)^2/4)+eta((1-mu)^2/4)+(1-mu^2)-eta(mu^2)/2, eta(x)=-x log2 x; D_ref=sum KL(P_j||Q_j)/2-KL(R||q)>=0 equals (1+mu^2)/2 times Bernoulli KL between mu^2/(1+mu^2) and Q(empty)/(1+Q(empty)). Every nonempty physical-label posterior is branch0, so this exact refund is concentrated in the empty row. The existing fine profile Gamma=max_{0<d<=1}[4-4d+Ppair(d)/d], Ppair(d)=eta((1-d)^2)+eta(d^2)-eta((1-2d)^2)/2, obeys 4.872<Gamma<4.873 and Psi(mu)<=Gamma(1-|mu|)/2. Hence supplied costs c_j<=C_j I(g_j) imply CE_QF<=max(Gamma,C_1,...,C_r) I(F), with one shared physical budget and no repeated additive merge overhead. A self-contained weaker profile bound is gamma_0=4+5/(8ln2)<5. Comparing this joint prior to the product of individually lifted module marginals is signed: for private point-defect cores of dimensions3 and2 with eligible uniform references (costs3,2<=5 times influences3/4,1), CE_separate-CE_joint=(128ln2+73ln11-127ln3-80ln5)/(128ln2)<0, certified by 2^128*11^73<3^127*5^80. Exact core references instead refund TC, including the prior eleven-bit positive-excess control. No universal supply of terminal certificates, nonconstant fallback or history transfer is asserted.
